data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate had higher overall loss ratios than its Syndicate Business Forecast, with the 2015 year of account suffering deterioration in respect of new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims.
data.standardized_narrative: The report indicates adverse development for the 2015 year of account, specifically due to attritional hull claims, leading to higher overall loss ratios than forecast. However, no overall quantified prior year development figure is provided. The claims development triangle only covers the two most recent underwriting years (2015 and 2016), which are not considered "prior years" for development calculation in a 2016 report. Gross premiums written for 2016 were GBP 76.319 million, with the largest segment being Marine, aviation and transport.
